title: Right Whales Went From 0 Calves To 22
hook: A species near collapse just went from 0 calves to 22.
closing: Recovery depends on protecting the few mothers capable of rebuilding the species.
question: Can right whales recover?

segments.say: Right whales reached 384 animals, a rebound that still leaves the entire species dangerously small.
Right whales produced 22 calves after a season with 0, proving recovery remains possible.
Only 70 right whales are breeding females, so losing a few can stall recovery.
